positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Engineering Manager
Senior Software Engineer, Computer Vision
positions.description:
Working on Self-Driving and related projects for Tesla Autopilot. Team focused on 3D perception, neural simulation, and real-world embodied AI

Major milestones/releases/achievements include:

Vision-Only Autopark: 
https://digitalassets.tesla.com/tesla-contents/video/upload/f_auto,q_auto,ac_none/FSD-Autopark-Desktop.mp4

High-Fidelity Park Assist: 
https://x.com/Tesla/status/1743701415208403092

Robotaxi launch: 
https://tesla.com/robotaxi

Driverless Customer Delivery: 
https://x.com/Tesla/status/1938816477127418224

Global customer FSD Launches: 
https://www.tesla.com/fsd

Cutting edge computer vision / neural rendering / world model work: 
https://youtu.be/IRu-cPkpiFk?t=745 (example presented at ICCV)

positions.title: Software Engineer - Computational Photography
positions.description:
Series C Cinematic VR startup that was acquired by Verizon Wireless in 2019 (https://variety.com/2019/digital/news/verizon-jaunt-asset-acquisition-xr-ar-vr-1203353568/). Products included custom hardware, a cloud VR movie rendering pipeline, and capture tools.

Worked on computer vision, image processing, and imaging problems for cinematic virtual reality

Projects included: 
Stereoscopic spatio-temporally stable panorama rendering
Joint multi-camera calibration
Adapting camera/imaging 3A pipelines for multi-camera / VR

Technologies include: C++, CUDA, OpenCL, OpenCV

positions.description:

Computer Vision (CS 231A) - Winter 2015

positions.description:
